index.heading: Front matter — page purpose
index.summary: KB page describing how the Merchant Routing Service routes authorization traffic to the correct brand handler. Explicitly reference material, not a change or mandate.

index.heading: Supported card brands
index.summary: Routes Mastercard, Visa and Discover. CURRENT STATE: card brand is resolved from the PAN BIN range during authorization.

index.heading: Routing
index.summary: After brand resolution the router dispatches to a brand-specific handler (mc_handler, visa_handler, discover_handler). Routing is table-driven and reloadable without a deploy.

index.heading: Transaction flow
index.summary: Authorization -> brand resolution -> handler dispatch -> response normalization -> ledger write, each step emitting a tracing span.

index.heading: Error handling
index.summary: When a brand handler is unavailable the router applies the configured fallback and records EBRAND_UNAVAILABLE; retries are bounded.
